trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a sharply defined vertex; lobes converge at an angle of approximately 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary; the left lobe displays a series of small, relatively uniform peaks, while the right lobe features larger, jagged dentate processes with deep interstitial gaps.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: pronounced concave curvature originating from the median notch and extending toward the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity white pixels at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with localized barnacle colonization or residual scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular material loss and deep indentations along the inner margin of the right lobe adjacent to the median notch.
